PrototypeNotes.Database: Metadata validation only. No adapter is implemented; any provider configured outside Demo is rejected. No credentials are loaded.
PrototypeNotes.AI: Metadata only. Outbound calls cannot be enabled by configuration in this prototype.
PrototypeNotes.Demo: Requires Development. APIs are loopback-only. Feedback retains at most 200 items in process memory and is lost on restart.
PrototypeNotes.Authentication: Not implemented. Non-Demo business APIs always fail closed.
